name: Document Vault
purpose: Create the document upload, request, analysis, verification, fraud-signal, storage monitoring, and candidate smart-intake extraction bridge foundation.
document_laws: Candidate documents must never be treated as public files.
Every document must belong to a candidate.
Every document must have type, status, storage reference, and evidence reference.
Document extraction may prefill smart forms but may not silently become trusted profile data.
Candidate confirmation is required for extracted personal fields.
Operator approval is required for sensitive document or identity conflicts.
Fraud signals are alerts, not final guilt decisions.
AI may assist analysis but must not make final fraud, privacy, payment, refund, or official-submission decisions.
Storage must be monitored for size, checksum, lifecycle, and protection status.
Document requests must explain why each document is needed.
Manual fallback must include document readiness status.
